content: ‘Rebel teacher’ to contest Victorian education minister’s seat in state election A group of self-described “rebel teachers” in Victoria are running a campaign to target eight sitting Labor MPs, including the minister for education, Ben Carroll, in November’s state election. The candidates are members of the “Socialists in Schools” group, in opposition to the department of education. Victorian Socialists have announced they are aiming to contest every lower house seat in Victoria. Brendan Laws is going up against Carroll in his formerly safe seat of Niddrie, calling for the ending of public funding to high-fee private schools, the abolition of Naplan and full funding for uniforms, excursions, materials and lunches. Laws said the Victorian school system had been underfunded for years. There’s a consensus that public education deserves better. On the issue of education, the ALP is not just out of touch – they’re on the other side of the picket line, with the Liberals and One Nation. Economic segregation is increasing, as working-class students are more and isolated while high-fee private schools get more and more funding each year. This must end immediately. In sporting news, the Commonwealth Games is on! Australia is sitting at the top of the table at the pared-back event with 12 gold and 23 medals overall. Swimming Australia may be turning the Tollcross Swimming Centre into their own Commonwealth Games pleasure dome after their two “Super Sams” – Sam Short and Sam Williamson – led another remarkable parade of five gold medals. Mollie O’Callaghan threw aside her “unlucky stick” to win the 200m freestyle, Alex Perkins cast off her “bridesmaid” tag to earn her first major individual crown in the 50m butterfly, and Kyle Chalmers won a ninth gold in the mixed freestyle relay to home in on Games history. Pride of place, as the Dolphins secured nine medals in total after their opening-day haul of six golds, went to muscle-flexing Short, who led an Australian 1-2-3 in the 400m freestyle, and Williamson, who downed British great Adam Ramsay-Peaty in a thrilling 100m breaststroke final. Only a year ago, Williamson feared he may never walk again after rupturing his patella tendon in training. But the 28-year-old Victorian was left a picture of emotion at poolside as he thanked his family after beating world record-holder Ramsay-Peaty, who was consigned to bronze: Mentally it was the toughest challenge I’ve ever had to face … Every single day I wanted to throw in the towel, but I knew how far I’d come to get to that point. Star gymnast Georgia Godwin has also become Australia’s most decorated women’s gymnast at the games after Australia took the team gold medal with a final score of 158.400 points at Glasgow international arena on Sunday morning Aest. -with AAP. A Sunday listen: Malinauskas on One Nation, Aukus and the politics of persuasion Are you looking for something to delight your eardrums on a leisurely Sunday morning? Search no more! Over on Guardian Australia’s Full Story podcast, our political editor, Tom McIlroy, and chief political correspondent, Dan Jervis-Bardy, speak with South Australia’s premier, Peter Malinauskas, at the 50th Labor conference in Adelaide. Malinauskas talks about his own state contest with One Nation and why progressives should not talk down to Pauline Hanson’s supporters. And despite the US admitting this week that the production rate of Virginia-class submarines has not increased, the SA premier argues that abandoning Aukus would pose an even greater risk than the controversial agreement’s potential problems. Listen here: Push for government to double funding to councils ‘running on empty’ The Australian Services Union (ASU) is pushing for the doubling of federal funding for councils to address gaps in services. It’s been a big topic at this week’s ALP national conference, with the unions representing local government workers urging conference delegates to support a motion restoring financial assistance grants to 1% of federal taxation revenue. The grants currently sit at 0.49% after the former Coalition froze indexation of federal grants. The national secretary of the ASU, Emeline Gaske, said: “Canberra must restore the 1% benchmark because councils are running on empty.” The Local Government NSW president and Inner West mayor, Darcy Byrne, said there was a “real crisis in funding for local government”. In many regional communities, in particular, there is simply not enough funding for basic services to be maintained. Financial Assistance Grants have fallen from 1% of commonwealth taxation revenue to barely half that over 30 years. Without action now there’s a real danger of councils having to not only cut basic services but shut their doors altogether. NSW considers reforms to strengthen protections for sexual assault victim-survivors The New South Wales government is commissioning independent research on how to better protect the counselling records of sexual assault victim-survivors in the criminal justice system. The research will look at how existing protections under the state’s Sexual Assault Communications Privilege (SACP) are operating and consider whether reform is required following concerns raised by victim-survivors over the negative impact of having counselling notes subpoenaed. The attorney general, Michael Daley said the government knew “the criminal justice system can be difficult and re-traumatising for victim-survivors of sexual violence”. That’s why the Government is looking at ways to improve the experience of complainants in criminal proceedings. This important research will consider existing protections for counselling records in sexual assault matters and how the system can be strengthened to reduce trauma to victim-survivors. chineseContent: “反叛教师”将在州选举中争夺维多利亚州教育部长席位 维多利亚州一群自称“反叛教师”的人正在开展一场运动，目标是在 11 月的州选举中瞄准八名现任工党议员，其中包括教育部长本·卡罗尔 (Ben Carroll)。候选人是“学校社会主义者”团体的成员，反对教育部。维多利亚社会党宣布他们的目标是竞选维多利亚州的每个下议院席位。布伦丹·劳斯 (Brendan Laws) 在他以前安全的尼德里 (Niddrie) 席位上与卡罗尔 (Carroll) 对抗，呼吁停止向高收费私立学校提供公共资助，废除纳普兰 (Naplan) 并为校服、短途旅行、材料和午餐提供全额资助。劳斯表示，维多利亚州的学校系统多年来一直资金不足。人们一致认为公共教育值得更好。在教育问题上，工党不仅脱节——他们与自由党和一国党站在纠察线的另一边。经济隔离正在加剧，工薪阶层学生越来越孤立，而高收费私立学校每年获得越来越多的资金。这必须立即结束。体育新闻：英联邦运动会即将开幕！澳大利亚在这项规模较小的赛事中以 12 枚金牌和 23 枚奖牌的成绩位居榜首。澳大利亚游泳协会可能正在将托尔克罗斯游泳中心变成他们自己的英联邦运动会娱乐圆顶，此前他们的两位“超级萨姆”——萨姆·肖特和萨姆·威廉姆森——带领了另一场引人注目的五枚金牌游行。莫莉·奥卡拉汉 (Mollie O’Callaghan) 扔掉了她的“倒霉棒”，赢得了 200 米自由泳冠军；亚历克斯·帕金斯 (Alex Perkins) 摆脱了“伴娘”标签，赢得了她在 50 米蝶泳比赛中的首个个人大满贯冠军；凯尔·查默斯 (Kyle Chalmers) 在混合自由泳接力赛中赢得了第九枚金牌
